newsitem.title: FRANCE: Remy to sell Seagram brands in Barbados.
newsitem.headline: Remy to sell Seagram brands in Barbados.

text.p: French drinks group Remy-Cointreau said in a statement on Monday that its Mount Gay Distilleries Ltd unit had signed an agreement with Seagram to distribute Seagram wines and spirits in Barbados.
A Remy spokeswoman declined to disclose the terms of the agreement.

Remy acquired Mount Gay, best known for its rum, in 1989. Under the agreement, Mount Gay will distribute Seagram brands including Chivas Regal, Crown Royal, Seagram VO and Absolut Vodka in the Caribbean luxury resort and its duty free market.
